subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: the work-item store is **bucket-1 operand content** (footprint #DINV-1) — it is the user's backlog, git-versioned, and it *survives* `pyxis remove`; it is never placed under the system footprint (bucket 2, which uninstall deletes — losing the store). Its root is the closed-schema key `paths.work_items` on the footprint's closed config surface, defaulting to **`.workitems/`** at the operand root (v2's one delta — a dot-directory keeps the operand root clean; the key's mechanics are unchanged, so any operand may pin a different root, including v1's `work-items/`). The dot-directory carries an honest cost, accepted: hidden-skipping tools (`rg`, `fd`, shell globs, Finder) need `--hidden` or an explicit path to see the store — `git grep`/`git diff`/`grep -r`/`find` are unaffected, the store's primary reader is the machine, and A-8's legibility bar is read with the store path explicit. Implementation note: the default resolves at exactly one code point (the config default the `carina` CLI and, through it, plangate's projection consume); the flip, this repo's store rename, and nothing else move together, and frozen sibling designs whose prose names `work-items/` (e.g. the carina adapter's `ls` example) read as v1-era defaults; the signal vocabulary and any store metadata live under that same root, versioned with the backlog. This adds exactly one config key to the phase-1 surface and touches nothing else in it.
